headline: SM Prime, Tzu Chi to build hospital at Mall of Asia complex
summary: SM Prime Holdings is partnering with Tzu Chi Foundation Philippines to develop a tertiary hospital with more than 400 beds in Pasay City. The Tzu Chi Medical Center will serve both paying and indigent patients.
why: SM Prime is a major Philippine property developer with large mall and residential holdings. Its push into healthcare real estate diversifies its mixed-use portfolio.
